description: This file implements a security-related component for a web browser environment, including functions for token retrieval from WebKit frames and JavaScript injection into web frames, specifically within a security agent namespace.

methods.name: thunderToken
methods.description: Retrieves a token string based on the URI of a web frame, used for security or authentication purposes.

methods.name: InjectJS
methods.description: Injects JavaScript code into a WebKit frame to embed a security token as a property in the JavaScript context.
